common.empty: There are no items in this list.
common.emptyWindow: There are no items in this window. The next page may contain results.
common.failed: The operation could not be completed. Your input is preserved; you can retry.
common.saved: Decision recorded in the audit log.
common.reasonHint: Explain the decision without copying contact details, secrets or private content.
common.reasonInvalid: The reason must contain between {{min}} and 500 characters.
common.adminRequired: This configuration requires the platform administrator role.
common.selectNetwork: Select a network to open these tools.
common.draftNotice: Unsaved input or pending decisions are present. Complete or cancel them before changing sections or networks.
common.discardDraftConfirm: This change may discard unsaved input. Continue?
common.pendingChangeBlocked: A decision is pending. Wait for its result before changing views.

teams.title: Moderation teams
teams.lead: Capabilities are rechecked in the network. Members who are unpublished or no longer listed in the directory are shown with a neutral label.
teams.name: Team name
teams.nameInvalid: The name must contain between 2 and 100 characters.
teams.handleHint: Look up a published network member; a technical ID grants no access.
teams.handleInvalid: Enter a handle between 1 and 64 characters.
teams.notFound: No visible member matches this handle.
teams.noMembers: There are no members in this team.

moderationPolicy.title: Network moderation settings
moderationPolicy.lead: Per surface: pre-review, link limit and pace beyond which a write goes to review before it becomes visible. Same settings as the network administrator’s “Settings” tab; every decision needs a reason, is recorded in the log and applies to later writes.
moderationPolicy.exceptions: Without a setting, shop offers and terms, job offers, service reviews and their replies, page events and the posts in their galleries wait for review. DIASPORALE’s own content (mutual aid, mentoring, arrival kit, jobs) is published without automatic checks.
moderationPolicy.withoutDefaults: No setting: engine defaults (pre-review: {{review}}; at most {{links}} links; {{writes}} writes per {{seconds}} s).
moderationPolicy.withoutHeld: No setting: every item on this surface waits for review before it becomes visible.
moderationPolicy.withoutUnchecked: No setting: items on this surface are published without automatic checks.
moderationPolicy.maxLinksHint: Beyond this, the write goes to review.
moderationPolicy.maxWritesHint: Beyond this, the member’s next write goes to review.
moderationPolicy.windowHint: Period over which the member’s writes are counted.
moderationPolicy.numberInvalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
moderationPolicy.noneConfigured: No surface has a setting in this network yet.
moderationPolicy.summary: {{surface}} — pre-review: {{review}}; at most {{links}} links; {{writes}} writes per {{seconds}} s.
moderationPolicy.termsLead: A write containing one of these words goes to review before it becomes visible, on every surface of the network. Case and accents are ignored. At most {{max}} active words.
moderationPolicy.termHint: {{min}} to {{max}} characters, accents and extra spaces removed.
moderationPolicy.termInvalid: The word must contain {{min}} to {{max}} characters.

appeals.title: Platform appeals
appeals.lead: Open appeals for the selected network. Every decision is recorded in the audit log.
appeals.independence: The person filing the appeal and the operator who made the original decision cannot decide this appeal.

federation.title: Federation
federation.lead: Emitters, receipts, media transfers and dead letters for this network. Technical receipt does not prove that a mirror was applied.
federation.slugInvalid: Use 2 to 64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
federation.keyHint: Enter only the ANTSIA_FEDERATION_…_KEY reference. The key itself is configured outside the console and is never displayed.
federation.keyInvalid: The reference must follow ANTSIA_FEDERATION_…_KEY, with uppercase letters, digits or underscores (160 characters maximum).
federation.contractsHint: One contract per line. Allowing a contract does not create its business handler.
federation.contractsInvalid: Enter up to 32 distinct contracts in CONTRACT-V1 format, with at most 100 characters each.
federation.pageSyncHint: The connection supports official page identity and withdrawal, posts declared public, their withdrawals and media imports under the file guard. Voluntary agents will be connected later. An authorised emitter, its key and media origins must be configured.
federation.mediaTransfersHint: These states track file imports. Transferred media remain subject to file analysis before delivery.

mediaFailure.configuration: Media origins are missing or invalid in the server configuration. They must be configured before retrying.
mediaFailure.download: The download was refused or interrupted.
mediaFailure.obsolete: The revision was withdrawn or its source object became unavailable.
mediaFailure.admission: A file was refused by the admission policy.

federation.mediaRetryQueued: Retry scheduled. Files will remain subject to analysis.
federation.replayHint: Replay preserves the receipt and its envelope. A contract without a business handler will still fail.

receiptStatus.discarded: Personal event discarded, body not retained

failure.contract_not_allowed: Contract not allowed in this network
failure.identity_not_linked: IDN identity not correlated or access unavailable

outcome.deduplicated: The receipt is already applied. No additional processing was performed.
outcome.still_failing: The replay was recorded, but processing still fails. No mirror was applied.
outcome.applied: The update was processed and the dead letter is resolved.
outcome.discarded: The personal body was redacted without applying it. A new event tied to current consent is required.

pages.title: Pages and trust
pages.lead: Trust levels come from the engine. Official status is reserved for institutions and a recorded administrative decision.
pages.creationHint: This creates an Official institutional page. Visibility stays within the network; it grants no badge to a person.
pages.name: Institution name
pages.nameInvalid: The name must contain between 1 and 120 characters.
pages.handleInvalid: Enter 3 to 60 lowercase characters: letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
pages.countryHint: Two uppercase ISO letters, for example GA.
pages.countryInvalid: Use two uppercase country letters or leave this field empty.

trust.label: New trust
trust.hint: “Official” is reserved for institution pages. The displayed badge is computed by the engine from this trust.
trust.unchanged: Choose a trust different from the current one.
trust.confirm: Set the trust “{{trust}}” on this page? The decision and its reason will be recorded in the log.
trust.saved: Trust set and recorded in the log.

handle.label: New address
handle.unchanged: Enter an address different from the current one.
handle.warning: The previous address is not reserved and no redirection exists: links already shared to it will stop working. It remains in the page’s identity history.
handle.confirm: Replace the address “{{previous}}” with “{{handle}}”? Previous links will stop working. The decision and its reason will be recorded in the log.
handle.saved: Address changed and recorded in the log.

rescue.lead: Only for a page without an active administrator (active membership in the page’s network, not suspended). The designated person, an active member of the network, receives an invitation to accept.
rescue.liveAdmins_one: This page has {{count}} active administrator: the backup does not apply.
rescue.liveAdmins_other: This page has {{count}} active administrators: the backup does not apply.
rescue.none: No active administrator: a backup administrator can be designated.
rescue.pending_one: {{count}} administrator invitation is already awaiting an answer.
rescue.pending_other: {{count}} administrator invitations are already awaiting an answer.
rescue.federated: Mirrored page: it is managed by its source, never from this console.
rescue.inactive: Restore the page before designating a backup administrator.
rescue.unknown: This page can no longer be read by the console.
rescue.failed: The page’s governance status is unavailable.
rescue.handleHint: The member’s public handle, with or without @, in the page’s network.
rescue.notFound: No visible member of this network has this handle.
rescue.confirm: Designate {{name}} as backup administrator of this page? The person will receive an invitation to accept. The decision and its reason will be recorded in the log.
rescue.invited: Invitation sent and recorded in the log.
rescue.promoted: Backup administrator appointed and recorded in the log.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.lead: Dated operational tracking. Incidents are resolved without deleting their audit history.
incidents.networkScope: The incident will belong to the selected network.
incidents.globalScope: The incident will belong to the platform.
incidents.name: Incident title
incidents.titleHint: Describe the operational issue without personal data.
incidents.titleInvalid: The title must contain between 2 and 160 characters.

audit.title: Decision audit log
audit.networkLead: Recorded decisions in the selected network, newest first.
audit.globalLead: Recorded decisions across the platform, newest first.
audit.subjectLead: History of the selected subject. No technical details or private content are exported.

health.title: Network health
health.lead: Materialised queue and member counts. These numbers describe the engine; they do not prove provider availability.
health.notGenerated: No counts have been generated yet. Request a calculation to obtain a dated state.
health.building: Calculation is running in batches. Incomplete values are not shown as a final state.
health.dateMissing: The date of this count is unavailable.
health.queued: Calculation requested. Wait for the new dated state.
health.snapshotHint: Calculation spans several batches; this is a dated state, not an atomic snapshot of every table.

operational.title: Engine scheduled jobs
operational.lead: Technical observation shared by all networks, limited to job documents retained by Convex. Function names, arguments and error text are not retained in this dashboard.
operational.notGenerated: No observation is available. The scheduled observer must be connected and complete a pass.
operational.scanned: {{count}} documents examined, capped at {{limit}} per observation.
operational.complete: All job documents currently retained by Convex have been examined. This does not cover every function error or records already purged by Convex.
operational.bounded: The read reached a limit. Counts describe only the examined slice; zero failures does not prove that no other failures occurred.
operational.stale: This observation is more than fifteen minutes old. Dashboard freshness is no longer guaranteed.
operational.warning: {{count}} failed job(s) observed in the window. Use authorised Convex tools for diagnosis; private error text is not copied here.
operational.noneObserved: No failure observed in this slice and window. This result is not an availability guarantee.
operational.synchronousNotMeasured: Errors from synchronous queries and mutations are not measured here. Monitoring them requires a log drain configured by the owner. This dashboard sends no external notification.

legal.title: Report legal deadlines
legal.lead: Cases subject to the deadlines of ordinance No. {{ordinance}}, still open or under review, read live and counted by legal basis. No case or person appears here: the moderators' priority queue handles them.
legal.overdue: Legal deadline exceeded: {{value}} case(s) still open or under review.
legal.noneOverdue: No legal deadline exceeded among open or in-review cases.
legal.failed: Legal deadlines could not be read. The other indicators on this page remain valid.
legal.bounded: Read capped at the {{limit}} nearest deadlines of each status: beyond that, figures are minimums.
legal.clockHint: A case becomes overdue by this screen's clock, refreshed every minute. No external notification is sent.

files.title: Guarded files
files.lead: Every uploaded file is scanned (byte inspection and antivirus) before it is shown, and no upload larger than {{max}} MiB is accepted. A file held after an antivirus outage can be rescanned here, with a reason written to the log: it only becomes readable again after a clean verdict. These queues cover every network.
files.sampleHint: Each counter reads at most {{cap}} rows per status; beyond that, the number shown is a floor.
files.skippedGenerated: Produced by the platform (live recording): served without scanning, and traced.
files.skippedWithheld: Uploaded before admission was closed above the scan ceiling: nobody has scanned it. It stays held and is never served.
files.tooLargeForAnalysis: Larger than the scan ceiling: a rescan could not inspect it.
files.requeued: Rescan requested. The file will only become readable again after a clean verdict.
files.loadFailed: Files could not be loaded. No decision has been made; you can try again.
files.denied: This operator session cannot read the file queue.

export.title: Aggregate export
export.lead: At most twelve periods, without identities or free text. Privacy threshold: {{threshold}} cases and distinct authors.
export.suppressionHint: Small cohorts and sub-cohorts are suppressed. A suppressed value is not zero and is not reconstructed in the export.
export.failed: The file could not be downloaded. You can retry.
export.invalid: This aggregate projection cannot be exported; download is blocked.

legal.title: Legal deadlines
legal.hint: Legal deadlines (ordinance No. {{ordinance}}): those that fell during the period, met or missed. Same rule as the Transparency page: a period closed when computed, at least {{threshold}} deadlines from as many distinct authors, and no number below {{threshold}}. Their total is never exported.
legal.suppressed: Suppressed: fewer than {{threshold}} deadlines or distinct authors.

commercialContact.title: Commercial contact
commercialContact.lead: This channel stays closed until the network and shop enable it. Personal conversations stay separate.

contextualPolicy.title: Request conversations
contextualPolicy.lead: Opens or closes, for this network and for each kind, the private conversations that start from a service request, an accepted mentorship or a shortlisted application. Closed by default; every decision requires a reason and is recorded in the log.
contextualPolicy.existingHint: Closing blocks any opening, message and call; the history stays readable to the parties. Personal messaging stays separate.

paymentPolicy.title: New payments
paymentPolicy.lead: Allow or close new payment starts for this network. Every decision requires a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
paymentPolicy.providerHint: Enabling this policy alone does not configure a provider or make payment available. PRO.GA configuration and authorisations are still required.
paymentPolicy.existingHint: Closing this policy keeps tracking and reconciliation of existing payments accessible. It does not cancel or refund a payment.
paymentPolicy.enabled: New payment starts allowed by the platform
paymentPolicy.validationMissing: New payments remain closed: payment decisions and cross-system acceptance still need validation. A previously enabled setting does not replace these prerequisites.

servicePolicy.title: Quotes, appointments and services
servicePolicy.lead: Open or close, for this network, quote, appointment and fixed-price service requests to shops linked to PRO.GA. Every decision requires a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
servicePolicy.linkHint: Opening this policy alone makes no service available: each shop must be linked to PRO.GA with the matching permission, and PRO.GA re-checks its mandate on every request.
servicePolicy.existingHint: Closing this policy keeps existing appointments and orders viewable and cancellable. It cancels no appointment.
servicePolicy.enabled: Service requests opened by the platform
servicePolicy.validationMissing: New service requests remain closed until retention rules and cross-system acceptance are validated. Existing commitments retain their dedicated status and cancellation paths.

jobPolicy.title: Job openings and applications
jobPolicy.lead: Open or close, for this network, the display of job openings received from PRO.GA and the sending of applications. Closed by default; every decision requires a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
jobPolicy.linkHint: Opening this policy alone publishes no opening: the employer must agree to publication in PRO.GA and link its shop with the matching permissions. PRO.GA re-checks the mandate on every application.
jobPolicy.jobsEnabled: Job openings shown in this network
jobPolicy.jobsDisabled: Job openings hidden in this network
jobPolicy.validationMissing: Applications remain closed pending validation of retention rules and cross-system acceptance. Openings may remain readable; existing applications retain their dedicated status and withdrawal paths.

storefrontPolicy.title: Storefront publication
storefrontPolicy.lead: Sets, for this network, how declared storefronts are published: closed (drafts only) or reviewed admission, one storefront at a time. Closed by default; every decision requires a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
storefrontPolicy.closeHint: Closing immediately removes storefronts from discovery without erasing anything; queued requests stay and can still be rejected, but no longer admitted.
storefrontPolicy.autoHint: Automatic admission of verified memberships is not offered here: it awaits approval of the list of restricted sectors.

state.review: Reviewed admission, one storefront at a time
state.auto_verified: Automatic admission of verified memberships (in force)

queue.title: Admission queue
queue.lead: Publication requests, oldest first. Admitting publishes the storefront and creates its page if it has none; the reason for a rejection is shown to the managers.
queue.closedHint: Publication is closed: requests can be rejected, not admitted.

catalogPolicy.title: Shop catalogs
catalogPolicy.lead: Open or close, for this network, the display of catalogs received from PRO.GA: offers, product pages and post slots. Closed by default; every decision requires a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
catalogPolicy.linkHint: Opening this policy alone shows no offer: each shop must be linked to PRO.GA with the permission to publish its catalog, then attached to its emitter by a separate decision.
catalogPolicy.existingHint: Closing immediately removes offers from every read without erasing the received copies; a new order preparation requires an open catalog.

catalogMapping.title: Connect shops to their PRO.GA catalog
catalogMapping.lead: Choose a shop and its authorized emitter. Mapping creates no offer: only signed and applied PRO.GA events populate the catalog.
catalogMapping.chooseShopHint: Select the shop to configure on this results page.
catalogMapping.linkReady: The live link allows catalog publication.
catalogMapping.linkRequired: The manager must first establish a live PRO.GA link with permission to publish the catalog.
catalogMapping.categoriesHint: Food categories require the PUBLIC V2 contract and facets declared in published offers. A V2-capable emitter does not prove that a classified product has been received. V1 catalogs remain usable.
catalogMapping.emitterHint: Choose an active emitter in the same environment, authorized for PUBLIC V1 or V2. Browse the pages if needed.
catalogMapping.selectEmitter: Choose an emitter on this page
catalogMapping.noCompatibleOnPage: No compatible emitter on this page. Browse the other pages or configure an emitter under Federation.
catalogMapping.unchanged: This emitter is already connected to the shop. No new decision is needed.
catalogMapping.replaceHint: Changing the emitter starts a new catalog generation. Offers will wait for new applied PRO.GA events.
catalogMapping.enableUnselected: Choose an emitter to connect the shop

checkoutPolicy.title: Order preparation
checkoutPolicy.lead: Open or close, for this network, the private preparation of orders with shops linked to PRO.GA: summary and a fifteen-minute stock hold. Closed by default; every decision requires a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
checkoutPolicy.linkHint: Opening this policy alone makes no order possible: the catalog must be open and the shop linked to PRO.GA with the permission to receive orders. No payment follows from it.
checkoutPolicy.existingHint: Closing blocks any new preparation without erasing anything; holds already placed run to their expiry.
checkoutPolicy.enabled: Order preparation opened by the platform

networkRoles.title: Network leads
networkRoles.lead: A network’s leads are active members appointed by a platform administrator. A network moderator handles reports addressed to the network, those no team takes on, and reads the network’s log; a network administrator handles the whole queue, decides the network’s appeals and manages its teams. A removal applies from the next action; every decision is justified and recorded in the log.
networkRoles.managed: This network is governed by its own application: the console appoints its first administrator, then the network’s administration appoints its leads in the network’s application. Its directory depends on each member’s choice: only members who appear in it can be found by their handle.
networkRoles.inactive: No effect: membership suspended, left or pending
networkRoles.handleHint: Search for a published, active member of the network; the console creates no membership.
networkRoles.appointed: Role granted and recorded in the log.
networkRoles.unchanged: This person already holds this role: nothing changed.
networkRoles.removed: Role removed and recorded in the log.
networkRoles.adminRequired: Appointing or removing a lead requires the platform administrator role.
